scientific_integrity: Analytic proof establishes the all-degree statement; a NumPy checker tested 338 finite assertions and is not treated as an infinite proof. Rank-one defect and AM-GM are classical known tools.
scientific_limitations: Finite Blaschke degree N; fixed nonzero B(0) of modulus below one; 1 <= k <= N; every finite p > 0; no assertion for p = infinity or infinite inner functions. Novelty remains provisional pending independent historical review.
title: Sharp Schatten-power minima and inner-function jet rigidity in finite Hardy model spaces
